summary: Former Clearfield County, PA steel lookout east of Clearfield, built October 1928. A 1976 newspaper says it was pulled down; the register says 1978.

facts.design: Steel Aermotor tower, about 80 feet, equipped with an aviation beacon by 1929
facts.status_note: Pulled down in June 1976 according to a newspaper report; the register gives 1978. No source describes what remains today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A June 9, 1976 newspaper report says the tower came down the day before. The register gives 1978. The story uses the newspaper date and says the two differ.
Newspapers give 80 feet. A 1959 survey description gives about 130 feet overall. The sources do not explain the gap; the record's 24.4 m (80 feet) is kept.

notes_for_editor: Two sources. The Forest Lookouts page carries reprints of 1928, 1929, 1953 and 1976 newspaper items and a 1959 survey description, so the quotes come from that page, not the original papers. The register says removed in 1978; the June 1976 report says 1976. A Pennsylvania storymap is JavaScript-only and a county tower listing returned 403, so the current status of the Rockton replacement is not checked; the story says only that it was completed there in 1976. No source found on the site today; an editor wanting more could search for the Rockton replacement and for the Old Town park.
